tools.description: Post to the #edited-by-sparrow channel for Sparrow handoff and revision requests, and to the project channel for team updates.

actions.description: Post a structured handoff message or revision request to #edited-by-sparrow, or post status updates to the project channel.

parameters.channel_id: string — either #edited-by-sparrow channel ID or project channel ID
parameters.content: string — markdown-formatted message (handoff details, revision instructions, status updates)
parameters.mention_users: array — Lark user IDs to notify
parameters.attachments: array — Google Drive links or file references to include
parameters.pin: boolean — true for handoff messages to keep them visible

actions.description: Monitor #edited-by-sparrow for Sparrow's completed edit notifications.

parameters.since: string — ISO 8601 timestamp to read messages from

tools.description: Organize raw files into selects, receive edited files from Sparrow, and structure the final delivery folder.

actions.description: Create subfolders for selects, edited files, and final delivery within the project folder.

parameters.parent_folder: string — parent folder ID within the project structure
parameters.name: string — folder name (e.g., '_selects', 'video', 'drone', 'photo')

actions.description: Move selected or edited files into the appropriate folder.
List files in a folder to verify organization and completeness.
Upload final exports and revision logs to the delivery folder.

tools.description: The sparrow-handoff sub-agent packages raw select files and posts a structured handoff to #edited-by-sparrow for Sparrow to pick up and edit. This is the bridge between EEVL's shoot output and Sparrow's editing pipeline.

actions.description: Trigger the Sparrow handoff with raw files, shot list, and client brief. The sub-agent handles packaging, task sheet generation, and Lark notification.

parameters.raw_file_manifest: array — complete file manifest from shoot day
parameters.shot_list: array — original shot list from pre-production
parameters.client_brief: object — original client brief with deliverable specs

properties.google_drive_selects_link: string — URL to the selects folder

sparrow_task_id.description: Sparrow's internal task ID for tracking the edit.

tools.description: Tier 2 escalation — persistent Cowork workspace for batch transcription, multi-file quality analysis, edit brief synthesis, and color science research.

actions.description: Send a heavy analysis or synthesis task to the content-production Cowork workspace.

parameters.task_description: string — what to analyze or synthesize
parameters.attachments: array — Google Drive file IDs (raw files, brief, shot list)

returns.result: object — structured output (quality report, transcription, edit brief)

actions.description: Check status of a running Cowork task (also available via Dispatch from phone).

tools.escalation_criteria: Use for tasks that involve analyzing 10+ files, generating multi-page synthesis documents, or require extended processing time (>5 min).

tools.description: Tier 3 escalation — Computer Use for creator app GUI automation when AppleScript, FCPXML, and CLI tools all fail.

actions.description: Start a Computer Use session targeting a creator app for operations that resist scripting.

parameters.task_description: string — specific operation (e.g., 'Batch retime 50 clips to 80% speed with optical flow')
parameters.project_file: string — path to the FCPX/Logic project file
parameters.scope_constraint: string — what folder/project the session can access

pre_check: Verify AppleScript cannot accomplish this task
Verify FCPXML import/export cannot accomplish this task
Verify CLI tools (ffmpeg, compressor-cli) cannot accomplish this task

tools.escalation_criteria: LAST RESORT. Only when: (1) AppleScript fails, (2) FCPXML fails, (3) CLI tools fail, (4) task is high-value enough to justify cost. Never for routine operations.

tools.description: Tier 1 — AppleScript/JXA automation for creator apps. Always try this before Computer Use.

actions.description: Export Final Cut Pro timeline as FCPXML for programmatic editing.
Import modified FCPXML back into Final Cut Pro.
Batch rename clips in Final Cut Pro library via AppleScript.
Export audio stems from Logic Pro via AppleScript bounce.

tools.description: Tier 1 — CLI transcoding and processing tools. Try before Computer Use.

actions.description: Analyze media file metadata (codec, resolution, duration, bitrate).
Batch process photos (resize, convert, strip metadata).
